rendering.scope: Homepage only, including homepage-only colors for existing shared chrome; other route systems remain independent.
rendering.scroll: Native document scroll; no active HomeSpatialShowcase, Lenis or pinned chapter camera.
rendering.field: Licensed open React Bits Silk; DPR 1; 0.4 light opacity; 0.32 dark opacity; static fallback ground.
rendering.darkHeroContrast: Dark Ink foreground for title and supporting copy; maximum white-shader composite [93,107,121] yields 4.9115:1.
rendering.closing: Original Canvas ASCII wave; approximately 28fps maximum; DPR at most 1.5; decorative and aria-hidden.
rendering.visibility: Canvas drawing pauses outside visibility and in hidden tabs; teardown releases resources.
rendering.appearance: Existing site-color-mode cookie; read on server, updated by the appearance button.
rendering.provenance: docs/home-react-bits.md; no paid Pro template source bundled; no approved image comp for this direction.

narrative.overview:
The built homepage places usable creator tools inside a calm blue field. A centered product statement and two direct actions lead into a real resource workbench. Open community and blog-space sections follow in native reading order. A dark ASCII wave field and large serif IAVSE wordmark close the page. The outlined V, IAVSE blue, and English mission remain the shared identity.

This document governs the current homepage, including its homepage-only treatment of shared chrome. It does not make this composition a template for resource directories, community pages, blog galleries, authored templates, account flows, or administration. Their existing layouts, permissions, and visual rules remain in force. The user's latest Cloudlight, Portfolio, and Security references supersede the former protected glass opening and spatial homepage chapters; those are historical implementations, not current homepage constraints. These references establish a quality bar, not an approved image comp.
keyCharacteristics: Flowing blue light, cool reading surfaces, dark ink, and an explicit dark appearance.
A functional resource workbench near the opening, followed by distinct community and template compositions.
Inter for product content, a restrained serif IAVSE signature, and a decorative mono character field.
Native scrolling, modest magnetic and lift feedback, and complete content with reduced motion or no WebGL.

rules.name: The Readable Field Rule
rules.body: Keep text above the moving field. The dark hero uses Dark Ink for both headline and supporting copy, with shader opacity capped at (0.32); do not restore the lower-contrast ordinary dark-body color there. The reviewed worst-case white shader composite remains above (4.5:1).

rules.name: The Source Color Rule
rules.body: Colors and typography inside actual catalog and template screenshots belong to their source, not the homepage token palette. The sidecar's synthesized tonal strips are panel previews, not runtime tokens.

rules.name: The Signature Rule
rules.body: Keep the outlined V as the shared navigation mark. The serif wordmark belongs to this homepage's workbench and closing; do not replace other routes' identity or authored template fonts with it.

rules.name: The Surface Scope Rule
rules.body: Carry the palette and interaction care to future homepage work; choose composition from each route's purpose. This homepage's centered opening, workbench, and ASCII ending are not mandatory structures for other pages.

dos: **Do** scope these tokens and compositions to the homepage; preserve the independent rules of resources, community, blog galleries, account, and admin routes.
**Do** keep the outlined V, IAVSE blue identity, English mission, real links, and readable content above decorative fields.
**Do** preserve dark-hero contrast, visible focus, native scrolling, persisted appearance, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** retain actual catalog sources/licenses, qualified public-feed states, and labeled fictional built-in template examples.
**Do** distinguish the licensed open Silk component, original ASCII work, and reference-only Pro templates in provenance.
donts: **Don't** restore the discarded glass opening or spatial chapter stage as a current homepage requirement.
**Don't** turn this homepage composition or the fonts inside screenshots into a template for every route.
**Don't** make decorative motion necessary to read, navigate, search, or publish.
**Don't** invent public posts, customers, testimonials, user totals, engagement figures, or broader third-party reuse rights.
**Don't** bundle paid Pro template source or present this implementation as an exact reproduction of the reference sites.
